# Aura TV

> Aura TV is an IPTV player for Apple and Android devices, including iPhone, iPad, Apple TV, Android phone/tablet, Android TV, and Google TV, for user-provided M3U playlists, Xtream-compatible credentials, and EPG/XMLTV guide data.

## Key Pages

## Product Positioning

- Primary category: IPTV player for Apple and Android devices.
- Core search intents: IPTV player, M3U player, Xtream IPTV player, EPG/XMLTV guide player, Android TV IPTV player, Google TV IPTV player, bring your own playlist IPTV app.
- Aura TV is player-only. It does not provide channels, playlists, credentials, broadcaster accounts, sports packages, movies, series, catalogs, or content access.
- Users are responsible for the sources and media they add.
